title: ‘नक्कली’ कथामा वर्गीय शक्तिसम्बन्ध
nepali: ‘नक्कली’ कथामा तत्कालीन नेपाली समाजको वर्गयुक्त शक्तिसम्बन्ध र त्यसका आडमा निम्नवर्गमाथि गरिएको शोषक वर्गीय शक्तिसम्बन्धलाई देखाइएको छ । सर्वेक्षण, सूक्ष्म पठन तथा पाठविश्लेषणको विधि प्रयोग गरी समग्रमा विश्लेषणात्मक विधिमार्फत सामान्यीकृत निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत गरिएको यस कथामा सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनअन्तर्गत वर्गीय शक्तिसम्बन्धकोखोजी र विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । सीमान्तीकृत समुदायको निम्नवर्गीय आर्थिक अवस्थालाई देखाइएको यस कथामा ग्रामीण जीवनका निम्नवर्गीय पीडा, दुःख र सङ्घर्षको प्रस्तुति छ ।सामन्त वर्ग र त्यसबाट उत्पीडित निम्नवर्गको प्रतिनिधित्व गराइएको यसमा उच्चवर्गीय सामन्त धर्मवीरले शोषक वर्ग र निम्नवर्गीय सन्तवीर तथा मानेले शोषित वर्गको प्रतिनिधित्व गरेका छन् । यस कथामा तत्कालीन समाजमा विद्यमान उच्चवर्गद्वारा स्थापित ज्ञान, सत्ता, शक्ति, प्रभुत्व, वर्चस्वकै कारण वस्तुको उत्पादन, उपभोग र वितरणका साधनमाथि उच्चवर्गीय अधीनस्थता रहेको हुनाले निम्नवर्गमाथि अमानवीय ढङ्गको अत्याचार, विभेद, शोषण, दमन र उत्पीडन भएको देखिन्छ । यसो हुनमा तत्कालीन समाजमा स्थापित सामन्ती ढाँचाको विमर्शात्मक संरचना नै मुख्य कारण हो । यसमा उच्चवर्गले निम्नवर्गमाथि उत्पीडनकारी र दमनकारी व्यवहार मात्र गरेको छैन चरम अधीनस्थ अवस्थामा पु¥याई सामाजिक प्रभुत्व पनि कायम गरेको छ । उच्चवर्गकै कारण निम्नवर्ग व्यक्तिगत र सामाजिक न्याय, श्रमको मूल्य र सत्तासम्बन्धबाट वञ्चित हुनगई चरम विभेद, शोषण, दमन र उत्पीडनमा परेको देखिन्छ । तत्कालीन सामन्ती विवर्शात्मक संरचनामा सामन्त वर्गको उच्चवर्गीय नाइके धर्मवीरको षड्यन्त्रमा सन्तवीरजस्ता निम्नवर्गीय गाउँलेहरू पर्नुपरेको छ । तत्कालीन वर्गयुक्त समाजमा एक वर्गले अर्को वर्गमाथि गर्ने विभेद, शोषण, दमन र उत्पीडनको स्वरूपलाई निष्कर्षका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको यस कथामा तत्कालीन सामन्तवादी÷ पुँजीवादी वर्गयुक्त समाज र सामाजिक संरचना भएकै कारणले त्यस बेलाको विमर्शात्मक संरचना निम्न वर्गमाथि सत्ता र शक्तिको पहुँचका कारण शोषण गर्न कुन हदसम्म उद्धत थियो भन्ने कुरा देखाइएको छ ।
american_english: In the story 'Nakkali', the class-based power relations of contemporary Nepali society and the exploitative class power relation exercised over the lower class under its cover are shown. Using the methods of survey, close reading and textual analysis, this story presents generalized conclusions through an overall analytical method, and within cultural studies the search for and analysis of class-based power relations has been carried out. This story, which shows the lower-class economic condition of the marginalized community, presents the pain, sorrow and struggle of lower-class rural life. In this, where the feudal class and the lower class oppressed by it are represented, the upper-class feudal lord Dharmavir represents the exploiting class and the lower-class Santavir and Mane represent the exploited class. In this story, because of the knowledge, power, authority, dominance and hegemony established by the upper class present in contemporary society, the upper class has subordination over the means of production, consumption and distribution of goods, and therefore inhuman atrocities, discrimination, exploitation, repression and oppression have been carried out against the lower class. The main reason for this is the discursive structure of the feudal framework established in contemporary society. In this, the upper class has not only carried out oppressive and repressive behavior toward the lower class, but has also established social dominance by bringing it to a state of extreme subordination. Because of the upper class itself, the lower class has been deprived of personal and social justice, the value of labor and power relations, and has fallen into extreme discrimination, exploitation, repression and oppression. In the feudal discursive structure of that time, lower-class villagers such as Santavir had to fall into the conspiracy of Dharmavir, the upper-class leader of the feudal class. In this story, which presents as a conclusion the form of discrimination, exploitation, repression and oppression exercised by one class over another in contemporary class-based society, it is shown to what extent the discursive structure of that time was brazen in exploiting the lower class because of its access to power and authority, given that contemporary feudal/capitalist class-based society and social structure existed.

informal_english: In the story 'Nakkali', you see the class-based power relations of Nepali society back then, and how the exploiting class used that to lord it over the lower class. Using survey, close reading and textual analysis, the story draws out generalised conclusions through an analytical method, and under cultural studies it digs into class-based power relations. The story shows the lower-class economic state of a marginalised community, and the pain, hardship and struggle of lower-class rural life. With the feudal class and the lower class it oppresses both represented, the upper-class feudal lord Dharmavir stands for the exploiting class, while lower-class Santavir and Mane stand for the exploited class. In the story, because of the knowledge, power, authority, dominance and hegemony the upper class had in society back then, it held sway over the means of producing, consuming and distributing goods, and so the lower class suffered inhuman atrocities, discrimination, exploitation, repression and oppression. The main reason for all this is the discursive structure of the feudal set-up that was in place back then. The upper class didn't just oppress and repress the lower class; it also established social dominance by pushing them into extreme subordination. Because of the upper class, the lower class was robbed of personal and social justice, the value of labour and any real power, and ended up in extreme discrimination, exploitation, repression and oppression. In that feudal discursive structure, lower-class villagers like Santavir got caught up in the conspiracy of Dharmavir, the upper-class leader of the feudal class. The story presents as a conclusion the way one class discriminates against, exploits, represses and oppresses another in that class-based society, and it shows just how brazen that discursive structure was in exploiting the lower class, given its access to power and authority, in a feudal/capitalist class-based society.
